name: Dubai Racing Club (DRC)
note: 'Formed in 1992, Dubai Racing Club serves to organise and host horseracing at Meydan Racecourse'; the first 1981 Dubai meeting was 'organised by the office of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, ... Ruler of Dubai', and DRC's chairman is Sheikh Rashed bin Dalmook bin Juma Al Maktoum. Parenting to government-of-dubai is by the ruler's office link, not a filing.
